text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text: Yeah, going with this design was definitely the right choice~
choice_data_list: All that brainstorming really paid off.

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text: It feels so nostalgic now. I've still kept the notebooks from back then, you know~

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
Do you remember~?
There were so many ideas that were totally useless, weren't there?

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
All right. Just because it's a racing outfit
doesn't mean it has to be stiff and formal,
so playful touches are an absolute must, I'd say!
choice_data_list: Looks like you're having fun.
Looks like you're having fun.

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text: Fufun, do you understand?

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
You know, when I try to think through all kinds of stuff
and turn my vision into reality,
it turns out to be pretty tough.

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text: I just suddenly remembered that crowdfunding thing.
choice_data_list: Crowdfunding?

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
Yep. When you look at those kinds of sites,
there are tons of people trying to bring all sorts of ideas to life, right?

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
There are wacky ideas that you'd never normally come up with, too.
It makes you realize, 'Ah, these people are trying to give shape to what they love.'

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text: So I was thinking maybe I could try doing that in my racing outfit too, y'know?
choice_data_list: To give shape to my 'love'...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I agreed that it certainly sounded fun.
As I nodded along, Transcend suddenly made an expression as if something had crossed her mind.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Is she troubled by some part of the design?
I call out to her, hoping to cheer her up.
choice_data_list: I hope it turns out great.
I hope it turns out well.

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
...Mm. Yeah.
I wanna make something good.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The next day, we arrived at the gadget expo.
She thought it might give her ideas for a racing outfit, but...

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
I'm counting on you for some great ideas too,
Trainer-chan~!
choice_data_list: Is it alright if I voice my opinion?
Can I share my thoughts?

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
Sure thing.
Alright, ready... set...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: After checking out the gadget expo, I decided to brainstorm ideas with Transcend at a cafe, but...

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
"Pffft... That was totally indulging their hobby, huh.
Being able to record data through pen strokes seems practical enough, but still..."
choice_data_list: It's hard to grip!

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
It's all craggy and rugged for a magic wand, y'know~.
They went way too far with that design.
choice_data_list: Let's add it to the design proposals.

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
Ahahaha, no way that's... Wait.
The smoky scent from that delicacy earlier
is lingering on my fingers...

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text: Alright, I'll add this fragrance to the ideas too.
choice_data_list: I-I hate this so much...!

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha.
...Ah, but that electronic component
we saw embedded in the fabric earlier—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The notebook quickly filled up.
Joking around, laughing, and brainstorming seriously,
we threw out ideas for as long as time allowed.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: And what was created was...

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text: You know, this racing attire...
choice_data_list: Almost all the design proposals I submitted got rejected...
Almost all of the design proposals I submitted got rejected...

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text: Pfft, what made you think that'd work?
choice_data_list: Still, the functionality seemed pretty good.

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
Totally~.
Bless the gadget expo.

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
...Hum-de-hum♪
I just can't stop smiling~.
Hehehe.
choice_data_list: Because it turned out so well?
Did you just remember something funny?

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text: Well, that's part of it, too.

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text: "Right now, I'm just so overwhelmed with emotion that I actually found something I want to do."
choice_data_list: Hm?

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text: Just saying how much fun it was making it together.
choice_data_list: I was glad you let me help.

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text: Feel free to thank me, you know?
choice_data_list: Thank you so much!!

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text: Pfft, you're way too honest!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: For a while after, they continued to happily reminisce about the time they made her racing outfit.

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text: I'd say it's not wrong, personally.

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text: ...Well, I'd better get heading home soon.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I didn't get a definitive answer, but Transcend seemed to be having a lot of fun.
Waving and telling her good work, I watched her leave.

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text: Mm, good work, buddy.

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
"...Well, of course I'd chuckle
just remembering that."

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
I wonder if Trainer-chan will get a racing outfit too~.
Then we could once again—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Walking down the twilight hallway with a light step,
Transcend looked happy from behind.
